personal.name: Vishnu Paturu
personal.title: Senior Software Engineer
personal.headline: Building scalable web platforms, cloud microservices, and autonomous AI systems
personal.bio: I build resilient platforms where product engineering, cloud systems, and AI-native tooling meet—turning complex workflows into dependable experiences.

experience.summary: Driving system architecture, technical design, code reviews, client communication, and DRI live-site reliability for Microsoft, while coordinating technical execution across 5+ engineers.
achievements: Architected a fully autonomous agentic harness pipeline featuring a 3-level hierarchical orchestrator and specialized subagents that automates component delivery from Figma MCP token extraction to code generation, unit/interactive testing with Playwright, a11y compliance, and automated PR creation with verification reports, accelerating velocity by 50%+ across 150+ components.

Engineered self-healing automated code review and fix loops across multi-agent execution tiers, autonomously diagnosing and resolving build, linting, and accessibility regressions before PR submission.

Led full-stack engineering of the AICC (AI Content Composer) platform across React, .NET Core, and AEM, using Azure AI for document layout parsing and Azure Monitor for telemetry, reducing page creation turnaround from 1 to 2 days to minutes.

Built and published a plug-and-play Lit web component library (150+ reusable components) as an internal npm package documented in Storybook, standardizing UI patterns and cutting cross-functional integration time by 30%.
Drove system architecture, code reviews, and Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) on-call monitoring, maintaining 99.9% uptime for internal authoring tools.

experience.summary: Contributed to foundation AI model evaluation, training dataset curation, and containerized benchmarking environments.
achievements: Authored 200+ structured algorithmic solutions in JavaScript and Python used as training and benchmark evaluation datasets for foundation AI models, analyzing model fine-tuning and coding capabilities.
Built 40+ reproducible Docker container environments for AI models to autonomously reproduce, debug, and resolve complex issues in open-source repositories.

experience.summary: Delivered scalable full-stack web applications for enterprise clients (including CBRE) and internal operational platforms.
achievements: Led development of a scalable project tracking platform using Next.js, Node.js / Express.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL, integrating CI/CD pipelines to deploy across environments with real-time visibility for 50+ active client projects.
Built a schema-driven incident management portal for CBRE across React, Redux, Formik, .NET, and Azure, enabling non-technical administrators to configure dynamic workplace incident forms.
Optimized React web application performance through code modularization, lazy loading, and memoization, cutting page load time by 4s and boosting Lighthouse scores to 90+.
Implemented automated unit, component, and integration testing suites with Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress, expanding test coverage by 28% and reducing QA release cycles by 40%.

experience.summary: Built high-traffic web consumer features and secure checkout integrations for US enterprise brands.
achievements: Delivered interactive React menu components for Tropical Smoothie Cafe, increasing order-funnel user engagement by 15% through integrated Google Analytics event tracking.
Integrated ID.me OAuth-based identity verification into Spoonflower's React + Ruby on Rails checkout flow, securing promotional eligibility and curbing promotion abuse by 30%.

experience.summary: Advanced from early-career engineer to senior contributor across a 45-person distributed engineering team building P&G's global Trade Promotion Management platform.
achievements: Designed .NET microservices for distributed KPI calculations across 1,000+ SKUs, instrumented with Azure Monitor for API health tracking and production debugging, reducing report generation turnaround from hours to minutes.

Modernized frontend architecture with Angular and AG Grid, migrating a legacy monolith to a micro-frontend architecture using Webpack Module Federation and eliminating code duplication across 5+ regional applications.
Optimized high-volume financial dashboards using Service Workers and selective API response caching, reducing Time-to-Interactive (TTI) by 3s under peak enterprise loads.
Co-led feature planning with business and QA leads, improved release stability by 25%, and mentored 5 junior engineers through structured onboarding and code reviews.

Evaluated on OK-VQA benchmarks demonstrating robust zero-shot multi-hop reasoning

Reduced manual bounding-box annotation time by 80% for object retrieval datasets
